author: Independent education critic subagent (claude-opus-5-5); did not author or correct the reviewed artifacts

findings.claim: The new instructions say 'Later questions combine two topics', but the coverage plan's delivery order puts cross-topic items at q02, q07, q10, q14 and q15, and three of the last five items (q11 to q13) are single-topic. The plan itself says only that cross-topic items 'appear more often towards the end', so the learner-facing promise is stronger than the plan.
findings.recommendation: Reword to match the plan, for example: 'Some questions, more often the later ones, combine two topics.'

items.note: Section 5 now lists all 12 untargeted objectives with reasons. I cross-checked: the blueprint's 30 objectives equal exactly the section 4 primary and secondary set, and 30 + 12 = the 42 taught objectives, with no overlap and nothing missing. objectiveFormats matches objectives.

Section 7 now sets binding limits: snippets of about 8 lines or fewer, at most two objectives per item, and one decision each for q11 and q15. It requires value-free pilot timing ('timed at <commit> by run <id>') and sends any fit failure to the course owner. The blueprint keeps 15 items, 15 minutes and pass mark 70.
Each item now has exactly one primary objective and at most one secondary objective, and each of the 15 taught topics is primary in exactly one item (section 5 table).
Section 4 now gives a level for each item (Apply, then Analyze, then Evaluate) and its single- or cross-topic scope, and states the delivery order. So the step-up claim can now be checked.

The instructions are now short learner sentences with no calendar ids. They state the graded final quiz ending Course Review, 15 questions in 15 minutes covering every topic, the question types, pass mark 70% and the separate practical. allowedResources is now learner-facing. No protected values.

Section 6 now names the known collisions: q13 against Activity 1 of the scenario page and the choosing practice; q07 against the wrapper bank item and coding Task 1; q04 and q05 against coding Task 2, the grouping per-customer total and Activities 2 and 3 of the scenario page; q14 against the review page's findFirst().get() item.
